editorial.blurb: Dog Haus Biergarten is a spirited Lincoln Park hangout where creative hot dogs, satisfying burgers, and fried chicken meet a lively social scene anchored by Thursday night trivia and sports.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive Thursday at 7pm for trivia with an engaging host—it's become a local draw. The Cowboy hot dog (crispy bacon, cheese sauce, BBQ, Hawaiian bread) is a standout that keeps people coming back.
